name: local-agent
title: Local Coding Agent
description: Chat with a local coding agent (Pi, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) from Raycast without opening a terminal.
author: tnmt

commands.name: ask-agent
commands.title: Ask Local Agent
commands.description: Send a prompt to a local coding agent in a registered project and read the answer.

commands.name: manage-projects
commands.title: Manage Agent Projects
commands.description: Add or remove projects used as working directories for the local agent.

preferences.name: piPath
preferences.title: Pi CLI Path
preferences.description: Path or command name of the Pi CLI. Leave as "pi" to search PATH.

preferences.name: claudePath
preferences.title: Claude CLI Path
preferences.description: Path or command name of the Claude Code CLI. Leave as "claude" to search PATH.

preferences.name: codexPath
preferences.title: Codex CLI Path
preferences.description: Path or command name of the Codex CLI. Leave as "codex" to search PATH.

preferences.name: cursorPath
preferences.title: Cursor CLI Path
preferences.description: Path or command name of the Cursor Agent CLI. Leave as "cursor-agent" to search PATH.

preferences.name: extraPath
preferences.title: Additional PATH
preferences.description: Colon-separated directories prepended to PATH when running the agent (e.g. where node lives).

preferences.name: projectsFile
preferences.title: Projects File
preferences.description: JSON file listing projects. Projects added in Raycast are stored separately.

preferences.name: defaultAgent
preferences.title: Default Agent
preferences.description: Agent selected when the form opens.

preferences.name: defaultProject
preferences.title: Default Working Directory
preferences.description: Path of the project selected when the form opens. Must match a registered project.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

This extension is not meant to be published to npm.

" && exit 1
